synopsis: Chrono::Sensor is Project Chrono’s sensor offering, classified as open source under BSD-3 and listed as free; the glossary also includes it among open-source sensor-simulation options [f9124, f9076, f9080, f15949]. It supports camera, lidar, SPAD, GPS and IMU sensors, with OptiX ray tracing and modeled lens distortion, noise and lag reported in the tools chapter [f9078, f8495]. Its listed interface is the Chrono API, and the latest release found was 10.0.0, although the supplied facts give no release date [f9079, f9081]. Independent evidence includes lunar and off-road research, providing relevant application context [f9077]. Both the tools chapter and glossary report that physics-based ultrasonic simulation was not found in Chrono::Sensor or the other listed options; this is a reported evidence gap, not an explicit claim that such capability is impossible [f8547, f15950].
